workerResult.summary: Crumb Budget — track spending in snack units as a vaporwave arcade cabinet. Expense log (name/amount/category, localStorage persistence, glitch-out delete, snack-equivalent per row), snack converter (8 presets + custom snack with price, dollars → snack units with whole+fraction breakdown, emoji strip, quips, animated count-up on the clickable retro sun), weekly chart (last-7-days bars, $/snack toggle, tooltips, weekly budget bar with OVERDRIVE pulse). All sound synthesized via WebAudio (no asset files): add chord, delete zap, convert chord, error buzz, hover ticks, toggle tones, fanfare. Easter egg: click the retro sun 5x or enter the Konami code (up-up-down-down-left-right-left-right-B-A) for a fullscreen SNACK OVERDRIVE overlay (giant sun, katakana marquee, emoji rain, GALACTIC CRUMBS = lifetime total × 42). Vaporwave palette (ultraviolet night, neon magenta/cyan, laser lemon) with Monoton/Space Grotesk/VT323, CRT scanlines, animated grid floor, reduced-motion support. Build passes; preview serves real content with relative asset paths (base './').
